variables.camp_no: The camp's number as the admin set it on the camp (e.g. "162"). A camp without one sends no SMS (ADR 0046)
variables.date: Event date as DD-MM-YYYY. For specs templates, the first day of the collection window
variables.end_date: Specs only: last day of the collection window as DD-MM-YYYY; equals date for a one-day window
variables.start_time: Specs only: window start in 12-hour HH:MM, read after the fixed word सुबह (the admin form requires it before 12:00)
variables.end_time: Specs only: window end in 12-hour HH:MM, read after the fixed word शाम (e.g. 17:00 is sent as 05:00)
variables.venue: Camp, hospital or distribution venue name. For surgery this is the OT Schedule Day's venue_sms when set, else its full venue (ADR 0040)

dlt_portal_note: dlt_portal_body is the text to register on the DLT portal; each {#var#} is filled in the order listed in variables. dlt_body is the same text in MSG91 flow syntax. Spacing, including the double spaces in the specs templates, is exactly as approved.

templates.body: SNP के {camp_no}वें नेत्र शिविर में आपका पंजीकरण हो गया है। क्रमांक: {reg_no} दिनांक: {date} शिविर स्थल: {venue}। कृपया शिविर के दिन अपना आधार कार्ड अवश्य साथ लाएँ।
